sloka: भूताश्चार्था विपद्यन्ते देशकालविरोधिताः ।विक्लबं दूतमासाद्य तमः सूर्योदये यथा ॥५-२-३९॥
transliteration: bhūtāścārthā vipadyante deśakālavirodhitāḥ ।viklabaṁ dūtamāsādya tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā ॥5-2-39॥

translations.english: 'Just as darkness disappears at Sunrise, wellplanned strategies also fail at the hands of a thoughtless messenger when they are set in opposition to proper time and place.
